checks.descripcion: data.js exporta TITLE y por defecto de 8 a 15 fichas con id entero positivo sin repetir, name de 3 o más caracteres sin repetir (sin distinguir mayúsculas) y detail de texto
checks.cmd: cd {proyecto} && node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import items, { TITLE } from './src/data.js'; assert.ok(typeof TITLE === 'string' && TITLE.trim() !== ''); assert.ok(Array.isArray(items) && items.length >= 8 && items.length <= 15); assert.ok(items.every((item) => Number.isInteger(item.id) && item.id > 0 && typeof item.name === 'string' && item.name.trim().length >= 3 && typeof item.detail === 'string' && item.detail.trim() !== '')); assert.equal(new Set(items.map(({ id }) => id)).size, items.length); assert.equal(new Set(items.map(({ name }) => name.trim().toLowerCase())).size, items.length);"

checks.descripcion: createApi devuelve una función que hace un GET a la URL con sus parámetros, con Accept: application/json y la señal recibida, sin cuerpo ni token, y devuelve el cuerpo JSON
checks.cmd: cd {proyecto} && node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import { createApi } from './src/logic.js'; const calls = []; let reply = () => new Response(JSON.stringify({ ok: 1 }), { status: 200, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }); globalThis.fetch = async (url, options = {}) => { calls.push({ url: String(url), method: options.method ?? 'GET', headers: new Headers(options.headers), body: options.body, signal: options.signal }); return reply(); }; const api = createApi('http://api.test'); assert.equal(typeof api, 'function'); const { signal } = new AbortController(); assert.deepEqual(await api('/api/items', { params: { search: 'sol', page: 2, sort: '' }, signal }), { ok: 1 }); assert.equal(calls.length, 1); const [call] = calls; assert.equal(call.url, 'http://api.test/api/items?search=sol&page=2'); assert.equal(call.method, 'GET'); assert.equal(call.headers.get('accept'), 'application/json'); assert.equal(call.headers.get('content-type'), null); assert.equal(call.headers.get('authorization'), null); assert.equal(call.body, undefined); assert.equal(call.signal, signal);"

checks.descripcion: La función de createApi envía data como cuerpo JSON con Content-Type: application/json y el método indicado
checks.cmd: cd {proyecto} && node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import { createApi } from './src/logic.js'; const calls = []; let reply = () => new Response(JSON.stringify({ ok: 1 }), { status: 200, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }); globalThis.fetch = async (url, options = {}) => { calls.push({ url: String(url), method: options.method ?? 'GET', headers: new Headers(options.headers), body: options.body, signal: options.signal }); return reply(); }; const api = createApi('http://api.test'); await api('/api/items/3', { method: 'PATCH', data: { detail: 'x' } }); const [call] = calls; assert.equal(call.method, 'PATCH'); assert.equal(call.url, 'http://api.test/api/items/3'); assert.equal(call.headers.get('content-type'), 'application/json'); assert.equal(call.headers.get('accept'), 'application/json'); assert.deepEqual(JSON.parse(call.body), { detail: 'x' });"

checks.descripcion: La función de createApi pide el token a getToken en cada petición y lo envía como Authorization: Bearer solo cuando hay uno
checks.cmd: cd {proyecto} && node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import { createApi } from './src/logic.js'; const calls = []; let reply = () => new Response(JSON.stringify({ ok: 1 }), { status: 200, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }); globalThis.fetch = async (url, options = {}) => { calls.push({ url: String(url), method: options.method ?? 'GET', headers: new Headers(options.headers), body: options.body, signal: options.signal }); return reply(); }; let token = null; const api = createApi('http://api.test', { getToken: () => token }); await api('/api/items'); token = 'abc123'; await api('/api/items'); token = undefined; await api('/api/items'); assert.equal(calls[0].headers.get('authorization'), null); assert.equal(calls[1].headers.get('authorization'), 'Bearer abc123'); assert.equal(calls[2].headers.get('authorization'), null);"

checks.descripcion: La función de createApi se rechaza con un HttpError con el status, el mensaje y los fields de la API (statusText y {} si el cuerpo no es JSON), y da null con un 204
checks.cmd: cd {proyecto} && node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import { startServer } from '{semana}/3-proyecto/starter/server.js'; import { createApi, HttpError } from './src/logic.js'; const items = [{ id: 1, name: 'Alfa', detail: 'a' }, { id: 2, name: 'Beta', detail: 'b' }, { id: 3, name: 'Alfabeto', detail: 'c' }, { id: 4, name: 'Delta', detail: 'd' }, { id: 5, name: 'Omega', detail: 'e' }]; const server = await startServer({ items, users: [{ user: 'u', password: 'p' }] }); const base = server.url; try { const api = createApi(base); await assert.rejects(api('/api/items/99'), (error) => error instanceof HttpError && error.status === 404 && error.message === 'No existe la ficha 99' && Object.keys(error.fields).length === 0); const { token } = await api('/api/login', { method: 'POST', data: { user: 'u', password: 'p' } }); const auth = createApi(base, { getToken: () => token }); await assert.rejects(auth('/api/items', { method: 'POST', data: { name: 'Zeta' } }), (error) => error instanceof HttpError && error.status === 422 && error.fields.detail === 'Obligatorio'); assert.equal(await auth('/api/items/1', { method: 'DELETE' }), null); globalThis.fetch = async () => new Response('caído', { status: 503, statusText: 'Service Unavailable', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain' } }); await assert.rejects(api('/api/items'), (error) => error instanceof HttpError && error.status === 503 && error.message === 'Service Unavailable' && Object.keys(error.fields).length === 0); } finally { await server.close(); }"

checks.descripcion: Con un 401, la función de createApi llama a onUnauthorized con el mensaje de la API antes de rechazarse; con otros errores, no
checks.cmd: cd {proyecto} && node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import { startServer } from '{semana}/3-proyecto/starter/server.js'; import { createApi } from './src/logic.js'; const items = [{ id: 1, name: 'Alfa', detail: 'a' }, { id: 2, name: 'Beta', detail: 'b' }, { id: 3, name: 'Alfabeto', detail: 'c' }, { id: 4, name: 'Delta', detail: 'd' }, { id: 5, name: 'Omega', detail: 'e' }]; const server = await startServer({ items, users: [{ user: 'u', password: 'p' }] }); const base = server.url; try { const seen = []; const api = createApi(base, { onUnauthorized: (message) => seen.push(message) }); await assert.rejects(api('/api/items/99'), { status: 404 }); assert.deepEqual(seen, []); await assert.rejects(api('/api/items', { method: 'POST', data: { name: 'Zeta', detail: 'z' } }), { status: 401 }); assert.deepEqual(seen, ['Inicia sesión: falta el token o no es válido']); } finally { await server.close(); }"

checks.descripcion: login inicia sesión con POST /api/login y devuelve token, user y expiresIn; con una contraseña mala se rechaza con un 401
checks.cmd: cd {proyecto} && node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import { startServer } from '{semana}/3-proyecto/starter/server.js'; import { createApi, login } from './src/logic.js'; const items = [{ id: 1, name: 'Alfa', detail: 'a' }, { id: 2, name: 'Beta', detail: 'b' }, { id: 3, name: 'Alfabeto', detail: 'c' }, { id: 4, name: 'Delta', detail: 'd' }, { id: 5, name: 'Omega', detail: 'e' }]; const server = await startServer({ items, users: [{ user: 'u', password: 'p' }] }); const base = server.url; try { const api = createApi(base); const session = await login(api, 'u', 'p'); assert.equal(typeof session.token, 'string'); assert.equal(session.user, 'u'); assert.equal(typeof session.expiresIn, 'number'); await assert.rejects(login(api, 'u', 'mala'), { status: 401, message: 'Usuario o contraseña incorrectos' }); } finally { await server.close(); }"

checks.descripcion: listPage pide /api/items con search, sort, page y perPage, devuelve { items, page, perPage, total, totalPages } y pasa la señal
checks.cmd: cd {proyecto} && node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import { startServer } from '{semana}/3-proyecto/starter/server.js'; import { createApi, listPage } from './src/logic.js'; const items = [{ id: 1, name: 'Alfa', detail: 'a' }, { id: 2, name: 'Beta', detail: 'b' }, { id: 3, name: 'Alfabeto', detail: 'c' }, { id: 4, name: 'Delta', detail: 'd' }, { id: 5, name: 'Omega', detail: 'e' }]; const server = await startServer({ items, users: [{ user: 'u', password: 'p' }] }); const base = server.url; try { const api = createApi(base); assert.deepEqual(await listPage(api), { items: items.slice(0, 4), page: 1, perPage: 4, total: 5, totalPages: 2 }); assert.deepEqual((await listPage(api, { page: 2 })).items, [items[4]]); const found = await listPage(api, { search: 'ALFA', sort: '-name' }); assert.deepEqual(found.items.map(({ id }) => id), [3, 1]); assert.equal(found.total, 2); assert.equal(found.totalPages, 1); const small = await listPage(api, { perPage: 2, page: 3 }); assert.deepEqual(small.items, [items[4]]); assert.equal(small.totalPages, 3); assert.equal((await listPage(api, { search: '', sort: '', page: '' })).total, 5); const controller = new AbortController(); controller.abort(); await assert.rejects(listPage(api, {}, controller.signal), { name: 'AbortError' }); } finally { await server.close(); }"

checks.descripcion: saveItem crea con POST si la ficha no tiene id y cambia con PATCH /api/items/<id> si lo tiene, sin enviar el id en el cuerpo
checks.cmd: cd {proyecto} && node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import { startServer } from '{semana}/3-proyecto/starter/server.js'; import { createApi, login, saveItem } from './src/logic.js'; const items = [{ id: 1, name: 'Alfa', detail: 'a' }, { id: 2, name: 'Beta', detail: 'b' }, { id: 3, name: 'Alfabeto', detail: 'c' }, { id: 4, name: 'Delta', detail: 'd' }, { id: 5, name: 'Omega', detail: 'e' }]; const server = await startServer({ items, users: [{ user: 'u', password: 'p' }] }); const base = server.url; try { let token = null; const api = createApi(base, { getToken: () => token }); ({ token } = await login(api, 'u', 'p')); assert.deepEqual(await saveItem(api, { name: 'Zeta', detail: 'z' }), { id: 6, name: 'Zeta', detail: 'z' }); assert.deepEqual(await saveItem(api, { id: 2, detail: 'nuevo' }), { id: 2, name: 'Beta', detail: 'nuevo' }); await assert.rejects(saveItem(api, { name: 'alfa', detail: 'x' }), { status: 409 }); await assert.rejects(saveItem(api, { id: 99, detail: 'x' }), { status: 404 }); const realFetch = globalThis.fetch; const bodies = []; globalThis.fetch = async (url, options) => { bodies.push(options.body); return realFetch(url, options); }; await saveItem(api, { id: 3, name: 'Alfabeto griego' }); assert.deepEqual(JSON.parse(bodies[0]), { name: 'Alfabeto griego' }); } finally { await server.close(); }"

checks.descripcion: deleteItem borra con DELETE /api/items/<id> y da null; la ficha deja de existir
checks.cmd: cd {proyecto} && node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import { startServer } from '{semana}/3-proyecto/starter/server.js'; import { createApi, login, deleteItem, listPage } from './src/logic.js'; const items = [{ id: 1, name: 'Alfa', detail: 'a' }, { id: 2, name: 'Beta', detail: 'b' }, { id: 3, name: 'Alfabeto', detail: 'c' }, { id: 4, name: 'Delta', detail: 'd' }, { id: 5, name: 'Omega', detail: 'e' }]; const server = await startServer({ items, users: [{ user: 'u', password: 'p' }] }); const base = server.url; try { let token = null; const api = createApi(base, { getToken: () => token }); ({ token } = await login(api, 'u', 'p')); assert.equal(await deleteItem(api, 4), null); assert.equal((await listPage(api)).total, 4); await assert.rejects(deleteItem(api, 4), { status: 404 }); } finally { await server.close(); }"

checks.descripcion: pageInfo da el texto de la paginación y si hay página anterior y siguiente
checks.cmd: cd {proyecto} && node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import { pageInfo } from './src/logic.js'; assert.deepEqual(pageInfo({ page: 2, totalPages: 3, total: 10 }), { label: 'Página 2 de 3 · 10 fichas', hasPrev: true, hasNext: true }); assert.deepEqual(pageInfo({ page: 1, totalPages: 3, total: 10 }), { label: 'Página 1 de 3 · 10 fichas', hasPrev: false, hasNext: true }); assert.deepEqual(pageInfo({ page: 3, totalPages: 3, total: 10 }), { label: 'Página 3 de 3 · 10 fichas', hasPrev: true, hasNext: false }); assert.deepEqual(pageInfo({ page: 1, totalPages: 1, total: 1 }), { label: 'Página 1 de 1 · 1 ficha', hasPrev: false, hasNext: false }); assert.deepEqual(pageInfo({ page: 1, totalPages: 1, total: 0 }), { label: 'Sin fichas', hasPrev: false, hasNext: false });"

checks.descripcion: reduce calcula el estado siguiente para start, success, failure, remove y restore sin modificar el anterior
checks.cmd: cd {proyecto} && node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import { reduce, INITIAL_STATE } from './src/logic.js'; const freeze = (state) => Object.freeze({ ...state, items: Object.freeze(state.items.map((item) => Object.freeze(item))) }); const a = { id: 1, name: 'Alfa', detail: 'a' }; const b = { id: 2, name: 'Beta', detail: 'b' }; const meta = { page: 1, perPage: 4, total: 2, totalPages: 1 }; const loading = reduce(INITIAL_STATE, { type: 'start' }); assert.deepEqual(loading, { status: 'loading', items: [], meta: null, error: null }); const ok = freeze(reduce(loading, { type: 'success', result: { items: [a, b], ...meta } })); assert.deepEqual(ok, { status: 'success', items: [a, b], meta, error: null }); assert.deepEqual(reduce(loading, { type: 'success', result: { items: [], page: 1, perPage: 4, total: 0, totalPages: 1 } }).status, 'empty'); const failed = freeze(reduce(ok, { type: 'failure', message: 'Sin conexión' })); assert.deepEqual(failed, { status: 'error', items: [a, b], meta, error: 'Sin conexión' }); assert.deepEqual(reduce(failed, { type: 'start' }), { status: 'loading', items: [a, b], meta, error: null }); const removed = freeze(reduce(ok, { type: 'remove', id: 1 })); assert.deepEqual(removed, { status: 'success', items: [b], meta, error: null }); assert.deepEqual(reduce(removed, { type: 'restore', items: [a, b], message: 'No se ha borrado' }), { status: 'error', items: [a, b], meta, error: 'No se ha borrado' }); assert.equal(reduce(ok, { type: 'otro' }), ok);"

checks.descripcion: createLatest añade una señal a cada llamada y aborta la anterior, así que solo la última llamada termina
checks.cmd: cd {proyecto} && node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import { startServer } from '{semana}/3-proyecto/starter/server.js'; import { createApi, listPage, createLatest } from './src/logic.js'; const items = [{ id: 1, name: 'Alfa', detail: 'a' }, { id: 2, name: 'Beta', detail: 'b' }, { id: 3, name: 'Alfabeto', detail: 'c' }, { id: 4, name: 'Delta', detail: 'd' }, { id: 5, name: 'Omega', detail: 'e' }]; const server = await startServer({ items, users: [{ user: 'u', password: 'p' }] }); const base = server.url; try { const slow = (value, ms, signal) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => { const timer = setTimeout(() => resolve(value), ms); signal.addEventListener('abort', () => { clearTimeout(timer); reject(signal.reason); }); }); const latest = createLatest(slow); const first = latest('a', 100); const second = latest('b', 10); await assert.rejects(first, { name: 'AbortError' }); assert.equal(await second, 'b'); assert.equal(await latest('c', 10), 'c'); const api = createApi(base); const search = createLatest((params, signal) => listPage(api, params, signal)); const old = search({ search: 'alfa' }); const fresh = search({ search: 'beta' }); await assert.rejects(old, { name: 'AbortError' }); assert.deepEqual((await fresh).items.map(({ id }) => id), [2]); } finally { await server.close(); }"
